checkpoints.description: [1/5] plan: apply guidelines, self-checking and self-fixing to built projects

impact_assessment.why: Ensure AIKit guidelines that keep its own code correct also apply to projects it builds (anti-lazy, architecture, ADR register, workspace hygiene), closing the provider delegation gap and making the kit capable, self-checking, and self-fixing.
impact_assessment.benefits: Projects built by AIKit are guarded by the exact same quality and architectural invariants as AIKit itself; built-in guidelines gate catches stubs, junk-drawers, and broken ADRs; aikit fix self-heals project scaffolding and cleans stale buffers; projects receive AGENTS.md guidelines automatically.
impact_assessment.risks: contract: resolve_gates adds guidelines gate before secrets; dependency: zero external dependencies, pure stdlib; concurrency: gate runs under supervised() with whole-tree timeout kill; state: write_memory never overwrites existing project memory or AGENTS.md
impact_assessment.mitigation: Existing tests updated to expect guidelines gate; resolve_gates handles polyglot and Python projects gracefully; all unit tests stay under 1s.
